contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (55,901.89) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' repeated at the foot of all five Schedule A sheets, and is corroborated by summary line 4 ('From Line 1 Column A', 55,901.89)
contributions.detail: 77 Schedule A rows over five sheets sum to 55,901.89 EXACTLY, and each sheet's rows sum to that sheet's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' to the cent: p3 15,113.00 (17 rows) + p4 7,904.99 (17) + p5 19,134.15 (17) + p6 10,999.75 (17) + p7 2,750.00 (9) = 55,901.89. That equals the schedule's own printed grand total AND the cover's PROMOTED PER-PERIOD cell, Column A. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints the SAME figure 55,901.89 because this is the cycle's first report (Seven days preceding the Primary); it is retained as cumulative and is never summed as an increment. The cover ladder closes independently: line 3 (Balance at Beginning) is a SLASHED ZERO = 0 under the zero-glyph ruling, line 4 = 55,901.89, line 5 = 55,901.89, line 6 = 37,523.22, line 7 = 18,378.67, and 55,901.89 - 37,523.22 = 18,378.67.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (37,523.22) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the printed 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' repeated at the foot of all four Schedule B sheets, and is echoed at summary line 6 ('From Line 2 Column A')
expenditures.detail: 66 Schedule B rows over four sheets sum to 37,522.38 against the printed 37,523.22 - a delta of +0.84 IN THE FILER'S FAVOUR (his printed figures are the larger). The delta is TRACED by the page-subtotal gate to exactly two sheets and is NOT spread: p8 rows sum 2,491.17 = printed subtotal 2,491.17 EXACT (after row 15 was corrected 38.83 -> 38.87 by escalation, see escalation_note); p9 rows sum 9,721.33 against printed subtotal 9,722.13, SHORT BY 0.80; p10 rows sum 16,611.15 = printed subtotal 16,611.15 EXACT; p11 rows sum 8,698.73 against printed subtotal 8,698.77, SHORT BY 0.04. The filer's own four printed subtotals add to his printed grand total exactly (2,491.17 + 9,722.13 + 16,611.15 + 8,698.77 = 37,523.22), so the discrepancy sits between his rows and his own page addition, not in his carry-forward. NOTHING WAS NUDGED: every one of the 17 amount cells on p9 and all 15 on p11 was escalated to a tight 900-2500 dpi cell crop and each reproduced the recorded figure; on p9 the two cells that could each absorb the whole 0.80 (row 12 96.10 and row 14 533.16, both turning on whether a raised cent digit is a 1 or a 9) were compared against the filer's OWN arithmetically-confirmed '16' and '96' glyphs on the exactly-closing p10 and both matched the '1x' forms - so the closure is NOT UNIQUE and neither was changed (ADDENDUM C5). Both are flagged needs_review=1, as is p11 row 5. Trap F1.5 was ruled out on both pages by full-width footer crops: nothing is written between the last printed rule and the 'Subtotal for this page' label. The correlated-error screen is inconclusive by absence - this is the only Grunander filing in the chunk.

in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on the contributions side - both conventions were tested on both sides, as ADDENDUM G1 requires. Schedule A carries 18 rows the filer marks '(in-kind)' (6 on p3, 5 on p4, 7 on p7) totalling 2,789.33; monetary-only would give 53,112.56 and FAILS Column A by exactly that amount, while monetary-plus-in-kind gives 55,901.89 and closes to the cent against Column A, the schedule's printed grand total and every page subtotal. So this filer's in-kind gifts ARE inside his stated cash-column figure. Schedule B marks no row in-kind and prints no in-kind line, so the two conventions are identical there and neither closes the +0.84 delta. NOTE the p7 in-kind gifts are NOT double-entered as offsetting expenditures (the Voeks pattern of G1 does not occur here).
escalation_note: Two figures were settled by escalation, each confirmed BOTH by unique arithmetic closure AND by the filer's own comparison glyph (the ADDENDUM F6 standard). (1) p8 row 15 read 38.83 on the full page; a 2000 dpi tight crop shows cents identical to row 5's confirmed '87' on the same sheet and quite unlike the '83' of 13.83 on the exactly-closing p4, and 38.87 makes p8 sum to its printed subtotal 2,491.17 exactly - CORRECTED to 38.87. (2) p9 row 14 read 533.14 on the full page; 2500 dpi shows '16', stroke-for-stroke the filer's arithmetically-confirmed '16' from 2,623.16 on p10 - corrected to 533.16, which does NOT close the page and was kept anyway, because the glyph evidence is his own and the alternative reading 533.96 is contradicted by his confirmed '96' from 4,249.96 on the same closed page. Beyond those, all 17 p9 cells, all 15 p11 cells, 17 p8 cells, four p10 comparison cells and five donor name/state cells were escalated; every other one reproduced the full-page reading. The state cell that renders like 'CA' on several Schedule A rows is this filer's cursive 'Ut' - settled at 900 dpi against his unambiguous 'Ut' elsewhere on the same page; no state was inferred from a zip.

notes: Chad Grunander, Utah County Attorney (page-face office 'Utah County Attorney', party 'Republican'); index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the PAGE FACE governs and the coordinator may promote 'Chad Grunander' through office_overrides.csv (the Ainge precedent). 11 pages, legacy_colAB: p1 cover ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election', not an amendment, signed 6/19/2018, clerk stamp JUN 19), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed heading), pp3-7 SCHEDULE A foliated 'Page 1..5 of 5', pp8-11 SCHEDULE B foliated 'Page 1..4 of 4'. *** GENUINELY 2018-DATED STOCK EXISTS. *** ADDENDUM G5 left open whether any sheet printed for 2018 circulates; this filing settles it - every inner sheet (pp2-11) is strap-lined '2018 County & Local School Candidates'. The stock is also MIXED within the one filing: the cover is the COUNTY-ONLY blank titled 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5) yet carries the school-board wording only in its vertical sidebar, while the inner sheets are the county-and-school-board 2018 stock - the ADDENDUM F6 finding that cover and schedule blanks were stocked independently, again. *** THE 2018 SHEET HAS SEVENTEEN DATA ROWS, NOT SIXTEEN. *** The brief's 17-rules-equals-16- rows rule does not hold on this stock: 17 printed per-column rules with text ABOVE each rule yield 17 usable lines, and this filer used all 17 on four separate sheets (crop-proved on every one). SCHEDULE B COLUMN VOCABULARY: this filing's Schedule B heads its payee column 'Provider/Vendor' - a FOURTH vocabulary alongside the three ADDENDUM G4 records ('Name of Contributor', 'Expenditure', 'Name/Nature of Expenditure'). There is still NO Purpose column: the filer writes each purpose in parentheses inside the Provider/Vendor cell, so `purpose` is populated from that parenthetical by CONTENT and `vendor_raw` carries the payee alone. PRIVACY: the county did NOT redact this filing (it is not a *_Redacted.pdf) and full street lines are visible on every Schedule A sheet; they are reduced to city/state at read time and no street line, box number or phone is carried into any field or note. Expenditure rows carry no address at all by contract. One donor row has a blank state for a real documentary reason (line 60, Celia Grenny: the filer wrote a city and zip but no state - ADDENDUM E4's fifth cause). One donor carries an APO military address (line 57). Five Schedule A cities are the filer's own abbreviations ('S.F.', 'P.G.', 'SLC') and are transcribed as printed, never expanded. INTRA-DOCUMENT DATE DISCREPANCY: the Date of Report box reads 6/19/2018 on pp2,3,4,5,6 and on all four Schedule B sheets, but '6/1/2018' on p7 - both recorded, neither adjudicated. Three p11 expenditures are annotated 'PENDING' in the address column (Facebook, Richard Jaussi, Brandmakers) - the filer reporting uncleared items; they are included in his own subtotal and are transcribed as ordinary rows. The 2018 County Attorney FILING FEE is 766.57 (p9 row 5, 'Utah Co. Elections'). Recorded as an observation for the wave's fee table only - ADDENDUM E1/F5 forbid using it to settle a figure on any other filing.
